{{Otheruses|Mytus}}
'''Mytus VIII''' was an imaginary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] devised by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], supposedly in the [[Mytus system/Legends|Mytus system]]. It was the planet assigned to [[Atuarre]] in Solo's scheme to determine [[Rekkon]]'s assassin.
